The '''Surgine-Series Fuel Accelerant System''' was a type of [[engine boosting system]] hardwired into a vehicle to enhance the performance of an [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. It was manufactured by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" />
